issue.title: UTooltip flickers when navigating a UTable row with arrow keys
issue.body:
### Environment

- @acme/ui: 1.3.2
- Vue: 3.5.13

### Description

When I use arrow keys to move focus between cells in `UTable`, any `UTooltip` attached to a cell flickers open and closed rapidly instead of just following focus smoothly.

### Expected behavior

The tooltip should show and hide cleanly as focus moves.
issue.author: keithw

comments.author: maintainer
comments.body: This is expected right now: UTooltip re-evaluates its position on every focus event, and arrow key navigation fires several in quick succession. Set `:delay-duration="0"` and `:disable-hoverable-content="true"` on the tooltip to avoid the flicker until we batch these updates.

comments.author: keithw
comments.body: That fixed it, thanks! No more flicker with those props set.
